items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: All be out of the same band. Yeah, this Hopskin fellow, he was using two trumpets then all the time.

ctx.x: Was that when you made the recordings with Palm? Yeah, yeah, same time. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. So, uh, you might have had some of the same men on the Palm records that you had on the Al Wynn records. That's a possibility.
Yeah, yeah. All be out of the same band. Yeah, this Hopskin fellow, he was using two trumpets then all the time. And he was there still all the time, see. He was Tiny right-hand man.
Yeah, I see. Now, the drummer though was Snaggs, you say, huh?
